events.title: The Buckle-Heart Ward
events.description: A huge patched shield props open a heavy rivet gate as the Warden inspects frayed brass seams.

choices.text: Spend 2 scraps to sew a lasting shield seam (+3 max HP)
Trade 2 max HP of rivets for 24 gold
Leave the rivet gate untouched

events.title: The Crimson Quilt Surgeon
events.description: A red needle and trailing thread stitch warm quilt bandages beneath a crimson canopy.

choices.text: Pay 12 gold to dress one hero's wounds (+8 HP)
Donate 4 HP of red thread for a purse of 18 gold
Leave the surgeon's quilt

events.title: The Copper-Needle Greenhouse
events.description: Crooked goggles and barbed gears glint among copper-wire ferns and needle-thorn blossoms.

choices.text: Spend 10 gold on soothing gear balm (+6 HP)
Endure 6 HP loss to salvage 3 scraps of barbed gears
Leave the copper greenhouse

events.title: The Thimble-Moon Vigil
events.description: A glowing lantern with a soft moth halo hangs beneath a pale stitched thimble moon.

choices.text: Pay 16 gold to strengthen seams in moonlight (+2 max HP)
Lose 4 HP tending the moth candles; earn 20 gold
Leave the sanctuary undisturbed

events.title: The Velvet Straw Mender
events.description: A tattered cape and needle rapier rest on a bed of warm velvet and straw padding.

choices.text: Spend 2 scraps on velvet straw stuffing (+10 HP)
Give up 5 HP worth of cape padding for 22 gold
Tuck the cape in and depart

events.title: The Strawheart Alarm
events.description: The Scarecrow hooks a quilted straw heart above a moonlit crow roost with a long forked pitchfork; black ribbon feathers tremble when it rings.

choices.text: Spend 2 scraps patching the straw heart (+8 HP)
Offer 5 HP of stuffing for 2 rescued scraps
Leave the crow roost to its midnight watch

events.title: The Starladder Bolas
events.description: The Ranger's giant braided wool bolas snag a moonlit ladder of crossed knitting needles, its silver rungs hanging between two stitched willow trees.

choices.text: Spend 14 gold for a stronger wool seam (+2 max HP)
Unpick 1 max HP of wool to salvage 2 scraps
Leave the silver ladder hanging

events.title: The Rivet Choir
events.description: The Golem's enormous chest buttons hum beside a choir of bronze rivets sewn into a midnight velvet bell, each bass note shaking its stitches.

choices.text: Pay 17 gold to polish a worn chest seam (+9 HP)
Give up 3 max HP of old brass for 27 gold
Let the bronze choir fall silent

events.title: The Blunderbuss Fuse Well
events.description: A huge blunderbuss rests against the Tinker's overstuffed scrap backpack as copper gear teeth catch sparks above an ink-dark wishing well.

choices.text: Spend 1 scrap reinforcing the blunderbuss lining (+2 max HP)
Endure 4 HP of hot fuse sparks to earn 21 gold
Cap the fuse and walk past the well

events.title: The Blackmoth Bell
events.description: The Lantern Monk's moth halo wheels around a giant black-felt funeral bell; its glowing lantern reveals warm stitches beneath the clapper.

choices.text: Spend 2 scraps to ring the moth chimes (heal 9 HP)
Unpick 2 max HP from the lantern wick for 22 gold
Let the great black moth-bell fall silent

events.title: The Needle Duel Ledger
events.description: A crimson cape hangs over a coffin-tall duelling ledger; the Rag Duelist's needle rapier pins an unsigned oath beneath one oxblood candle.

choices.text: Pay 15 gold to bind an enduring cape oath (+3 max HP)
Cut 6 HP of cape ribbon loose to collect 3 scraps
Withdraw the rapier and leave the ledger closed

events.title: The Crowbell Harvest
events.description: The Scarecrow's black crow pecks a bell sewn from dried leaves while its forked pitchfork props open an enormous straw-stuffed harvest gate.

choices.text: Spend 1 scrap packing the gate's warm straw (heal 7 HP)
Unpick 2 max HP of straw stuffing for 25 gold
Let the crow ring its lonely harvest bell

events.title: The Button Quarry
events.description: Giant slate-blue buttons protrude from a moss-lit quarry wall; the Button Golem braces its round fists against a loose brass disc as lantern dust falls.

choices.text: Pay 21 gold to sew in a huge quarry button (+4 max HP)
Lose 5 HP levering out a bronze disc (gain 2 scraps)
Leave the quarry's heavy buttons in the stone

events.title: The Waxwing Crossing
events.description: A great moth-wing bridge folds around a crooked lantern post; the Lantern Monk's glowing lamp reveals amber knots in the velvet crossing.

choices.text: Pay 24 gold to strengthen the wing-stitch (+3 max HP)
Lose 6 HP plucking hot amber knots (gain 3 scraps)
Let the moth-wing bridge fold behind you

events.title: The Thimble Duel Stage
events.description: Beneath oxblood velvet curtains, a button-eyed duelling puppet raises a needle rapier above a stage made from one giant brass thimble.

choices.text: Spend 2 scraps repairing the crimson cape (heal 9 HP)
Give up 2 max HP for the puppet's 27-gold medal
Bow to the puppet and leave the stage

events.title: The Woolwisp Waymark
events.description: The Yarn Ranger's huge wool bolas hold a stranded button-eyed wolf doll high above a moss-green needle-loom signpost.

choices.text: Pay 19 gold for a warm wolf-wool lining (heal 10 HP)
Lose 5 HP freeing the wool-wolf (gain 2 scraps)
Leave the woolwisp dangling by the waymark

events.title: The Gilt Button Turnstile
events.description: An enormous four-hole gilded button turns like a gate beneath a black chapel arch; the Button Golem's round fists steady its rattling rim.

choices.text: Spend 3 scraps on a lasting brass-button seam (+4 max HP)
Lose 6 HP prying out the brass rim (gain 29 gold)
Let the great button turn without you

events.title: The Amber Moth Nest
events.description: The Lantern Monk finds a huge quilted moth cocoon hanging in a crooked bone-cream belfry; a single amber flame glows through its stitched silk ribs.

choices.text: Pay 14 gold to rekindle the nest wick (heal 8 HP)
Unspool hot cocoon silk (lose 5 HP; gain 2 scraps)
Leave the amber moth asleep in its silk

events.title: The Duel-Mask Mirror
events.description: The Rag Duelist faces a cape-wide oxblood mirror where a button-eyed masked double holds a needle rapier through a torn velvet sash.

choices.text: Spend 2 scraps binding the mirror-cape (heal 4 HP; gain 2 max HP)
Pawn the reflected cape lining (lose 3 max HP; gain 28 gold)
Cover the duel mirror and depart

events.title: The Moon-Bolas Stag
events.description: The Yarn Ranger finds a plump midnight-wool stag tangled in her enormous braided bolas; pale stitched stars gleam along its soft antlers.

choices.text: Spend 1 scrap loosening the starry knots (heal 6 HP)
Gather the sharp star-wool (lose 6 HP; gain 3 scraps)
Let the moon-wool stag find its own trail

events.title: The Stormbutton Canopy
events.description: The Button Golem braces a thundercloud-sized quilted canopy under violet rain; massive brass chest buttons and one lantern hold its seams together.

choices.text: Pay 20 gold to fit a stronger thunder button (+3 max HP)
Shake loose the copper rain (lose 4 HP; gain 24 gold)
Let the great canopy weather the storm

events.title: The Rivet-Harp Causeway
events.description: A soot-dark bridge is strung like a vast brass harp; the Warden props its leaning rivet frame with a battered pot helmet and round stitched shield.

choices.text: Spend 2 scraps bracing the shield strings (heal 9 HP)
Trade 5 HP of shield lining for 23 gold
Let the bronze strings fall quiet

events.title: The Lace Marionette
events.description: A giant button-eyed lace marionette hangs beneath a crooked thimble lamp; the Seamstress threads her crimson needle through its velvet cuffs.

choices.text: Pay 18 gold to bind lasting lace cuffs (+3 max HP)
Unpick 5 HP of velvet for 2 scraps
Leave the marionette swaying beneath the lamp

events.title: The Oxblood Mothwheel
events.description: An oxblood gearwheel shaped like a moth hangs over a ruined toll booth; the Tinker's mismatched goggles catch its last copper sparks.

choices.text: Spend 3 scraps to add a lasting gearwing seam (+4 max HP)
Endure 6 HP of hot copper sparks to gather 27 gold
Leave the broken mothwheel still

events.title: The Crowbriar Weather Tower
events.description: An enormous black crow weather vane turns atop a thorn-stitched bell tower; the Scarecrow braces its creaking ladder with a forked pitchfork.

choices.text: Pay 15 gold for warm straw padding (heal 10 HP)
Unpick 2 max HP of tower straw for 25 gold
Let the crow vane turn without you

events.title: The Stitchglass Hourhouse
events.description: A cracked giant hourglass hangs from a black chapel rafter; the Seamstress guides its red-thread sand through the narrow neck with her towering needle.

choices.text: Spend 2 scraps binding the hourglass neck (heal 7 HP; gain 1 max HP)
Catch razor-fine threadglass sand (lose 5 HP; gain 3 scraps)
Leave the red sand falling in silence

events.title: The Brass-Lung Reliquary
events.description: A squat brass bellows shaped like a ribbed cloth lung breathes in a locked roadside shrine; the Tinker's crooked goggles mirror its amber valve.

choices.text: Pay 18 gold to pad the brass lung seam (+3 max HP)
Unpick 2 max HP of copper ribbing for 28 gold
Let the worn bellows breathe alone

events.title: The Crow-Pinned Toll Curtain
events.description: One black button-eyed crow pins an oxblood toll curtain to the Scarecrow's forked pitchfork; pale straw spills through the torn velvet hem.

choices.text: Spend 2 scraps on the crowsilk hem (heal 9 HP)
Offer 6 HP of straw to the watching crow for 25 gold
Walk beneath the silent black curtain

events.title: The Moonspool Ferry
events.description: A miniature ferry hangs from giant crossed knitting needles over a black river; the Yarn Ranger's white-wool bolas moor its dangling thread mast.

choices.text: Pay 16 gold to mend the wool ferry mast (heal 8 HP)
Unspool 2 max HP of mooring wool to recover 3 scraps
Let the little ferry swing across the dark water

events.title: The Shieldbell Mourning Path
events.description: An overturned brass mourning bell blocks a moonlit path; the Warden props its cracked lip with a vast quilted shield while stitched bell ropes twitch beneath.

choices.text: Spend 2 scraps shoring the bell's shieldrest (heal 8 HP)
Trade 2 max HP of old shield lining for 26 gold
Leave the bell quiet in the brambles

events.title: The Wax-Tally Ossuary
events.description: A bone-white cabinet of tiny stitched urns hangs above wax scales; the Lantern Monk's saffron pole lantern lights names sewn onto each hanging tag.

choices.text: Pay 16 gold to seal warm wax into the robe (+2 max HP)
Give 5 HP of wick-stuffing to salvage 3 scraps
Let the wax weights settle without a sound

events.title: The Velvet Needle Organ
events.description: A roadside organ of upright silver needles plays itself beneath oxblood drapes; the Rag Duelist's torn cape catches on a reed shaped like a rapier.

choices.text: Pay 17 gold for a stitched cape bandage (heal 9 HP)
Play the needle keys (lose 5 HP; earn 24 gold)
Let the organ hum behind the closed curtains

events.title: The Button-Eyed Gravestone Press
events.description: A squat stone press stamped with great button eyes leans over a patchwork memorial cloth; the Button Golem's round fists fit its missing counterweights.

choices.text: Spend 2 scraps resetting the button weights (heal 7 HP; gain 1 max HP)
Trade 3 max HP of brass buttons for 29 gold
Leave the buttons in their mossy sockets

events.title: The Bone-Chime Bellbridge
events.description: Over a crooked bridge of sewn wool slats, four enormous ivory button-chimes swing on black cord; the Scarecrow's pitchfork catches the clapper while a single dark crow watches from its shoulder.

choices.text: Spend 2 scraps padding the bell harness (heal 8 HP; gain 1 max HP)
Pull the sharp chime tokens loose (lose 5 HP; gain 24 gold)
Let the ivory chimes fall silent

events.title: The Stormkite Tangle
events.description: A vast four-corner quilt kite hangs in a black thorn tree, its midnight-blue tail snagged around the Yarn Ranger's braided bolas while one amber candle flickers beneath the branches.

choices.text: Pay 16 gold to sew warm kite ribs (+2 max HP)
Cut the barbed windknots (lose 6 HP; gain 3 scraps)
Leave the kite swaying beyond the road

events.title: The Iron-Mitten Sluice
events.description: At a drowned stair, a giant iron mitten grips the sluice chain. The Warden braces its swollen thumb with a patched shield while one candle burns inside the cuff.

choices.text: Spend 2 scraps on dry shield padding (heal 7 HP; gain 1 max HP)
Wrench out the brass clasp (lose 5 HP; gain 23 gold)
Leave the iron mitten clamped shut

events.title: The Whisper-Spool Archive
events.description: Hundreds of silent button eyes peer from a velvet archive wall. The Seamstress's red thread loops through whispering spools beneath a bent thimble lamp.

choices.text: Pay 16 gold for a lasting hush-stitch (+3 max HP)
Unspool a barbed braid (lose 4 HP; gain 2 scraps)
Let the silent spools keep their secrets

events.title: The Wind-Up Birdcage
events.description: A wind-up crow with a copper beak sleeps inside a towering brass birdcage. The Tinker's uneven goggles catch the single amber eye of its clockwork heart.

choices.text: Spend 1 scrap to oil the worn bearings (heal 6 HP)
Pry free a brass clockbird beak (lose 2 max HP; gain 25 gold)
Leave the clockbird asleep

events.title: The Needlefish Cistern
events.description: In an old wall niche, a giant glass cistern holds a silver-button needlefish; the Yarn Ranger's moss-and-teal bolas tether its woven tail while moonlight glints on a single cracked seam.

choices.text: Spend 2 scraps to mend the needlefish's felt fins (heal 9 HP)
Pull out sharp glass scales (lose 5 HP; gain 24 gold)
Leave the needlefish swimming in silence

events.title: The Mourning Glove Marquee
events.description: An oxblood velvet glove the size of a tent droops over an abandoned toy stage; the Rag Duelist pins its frayed cuff with a needle rapier while pale ribbons sway above the candlelit seats.

choices.text: Pay 18 gold to line the velvet cuff (+3 max HP)
Cut barbed tassels (lose 5 HP; gain 3 scraps)
Let the great velvet glove fall closed

events.title: The Starwheel Dumbwaiter
events.description: A button-faced brass dumbwaiter hangs over a stairwell as deep as night; the Button Golem presses its huge round fists against a painted starwheel to keep the thread-slung platform from slipping.

choices.text: Spend 2 scraps on a stronger hauling seam (+2 max HP)
Pull the brass axle pins (lose 2 max HP; gain 26 gold)
Leave the starwheel turning in the dark

events.title: The Mothglass Shadow Projector
events.description: A house-high projector of smoky glass casts huge stitched moth shadows across plum curtains; the Lantern Monk lifts a warm pole lantern to steady its trembling bone-white lens.

choices.text: Pay 14 gold to warm the shadow lens (heal 8 HP)
Salvage glowing mothglass thread (lose 5 HP; gain 2 scraps)
Let the moth shadows flutter behind the curtain

events.title: The Straw-Orbitarium
events.description: A crooked toy planetarium spins on a pitchfork axle above black shingles; the Scarecrow's shoulder crow tugs loose a stitched star as a giant straw moon tilts toward the road.

choices.text: Spend 2 scraps to bind a lasting moon seam (+2 max HP)
Pull the sharp orbit wires (lose 6 HP; earn 25 gold)
Leave the straw moon turning in the dark

events.title: The Domino Threshold
events.description: Bone-cream fabric dominoes tower over a narrow hallway; the Button Golem's broad brass-button fists brace the first piece while oxblood cross-stitches pull taut along the falling line.

choices.text: Spend 2 scraps to stitch the button brace (heal 7 HP; gain 1 max HP)
Pry loose a brass button pip (lose 2 max HP; gain 27 gold)
Let the dominoes stand in uneasy silence

events.title: The Inkwell Thresher
events.description: A house-sized glass inkwell shelters a tiny black-wheat field; the Scarecrow lowers its crooked pitchfork over the rim as a button-eyed crow taps the cork.

choices.text: Spend 2 scraps to pad the inkwell rim (heal 8 HP)
Harvest razor-black wheat (lose 5 HP; gain 23 gold)
Leave the crow to guard the dark harvest

events.title: The Sock-Drawer Aviary
events.description: A house-high sock drawer opens on a flock of knitted bird dolls; the Yarn Ranger loops white-wool bolas around its brass handle beneath a single amber candle.

choices.text: Pay 14 gold to retie the drawer (heal 7 HP; gain 1 max HP)
Take wool feathers (lose 5 HP; gain 2 scraps)
Let the knitted birds sleep inside the drawer

events.title: The Velvet Chess Knight
events.description: A giant bone-cream cloth chess knight kneels on a velvet roadside board; the Rag Duelist steadies its embroidered crest with a needle rapier and a torn crimson cape.

choices.text: Spend 2 scraps to brace the knight's crest (+3 max HP)
Pawn its brass bit (lose 2 max HP; gain 26 gold)
Bow to the cloth knight and depart

events.title: The Quilt-Press Switch
events.description: A brass quilt press towers above a narrow skirting-board path, its stack of oxblood blankets held by a single bent lever; the Warden braces the lever with a huge round patchwork shield.

choices.text: Spend 2 scraps to pad the shield brace (+2 max HP)
Strip the falling brass weight (lose 5 HP; gain 22 gold)
Let the enormous quilt press settle in silence

events.title: The Puppet-Lamp Infirmary
events.description: A milk-glass bedside lamp shelters a row of tiny sleeping rag dolls, its cracked shade bound with crimson thread; the Seamstress lifts her oversized needle to the frayed pull-cord.

choices.text: Pay 15 gold for warm lamp-lining (heal 9 HP)
Sell 2 max HP of crimson cord for 25 gold
Leave the little dolls beneath their amber light

events.title: The Spectacle Footbridge
events.description: A giant pair of tarnished spectacles spans a black rain gutter, one cracked lens turning slowly on a gear hinge; the Tinker studies its screws through mismatched goggles.

choices.text: Spend 3 scraps reinforcing the gear hinge (+3 max HP)
Salvage loose lens prisms (lose 6 HP; gain 3 scraps)
Leave the rain shining through the broken spectacles

events.title: The Silver Candle Snuffer
events.description: A tarnished candle snuffer hangs over a doll-size skirting-board chapel like a silver bell; the Lantern Monk cups his moth-halo lantern beneath its velvet tassel.

choices.text: Pay 12 gold for a warm silver lining (heal 8 HP)
Strip the swinging chain (lose 5 HP; gain 2 scraps)
Leave the little chapel with its snuffed candles

events.title: The Darning-Mushroom Lookout
events.description: An enormous wooden darning mushroom rises above a folded lace ravine; the Yarn Ranger anchors wool bolas round its stalk while stitched birds settle on the cap.

choices.text: Spend 2 scraps bracing the lookout seams (+2 max HP)
Unpick the splintered cap (lose 6 HP; gain 3 scraps)
Leave the stitched birds asleep on the mushroom

events.title: The Iron Washboard Chapel
events.description: A rusted iron washboard stands as a ribbed shrine between giant floorboard cracks; the Button Golem presses its loose brass buttons against the shivering metal grooves.

choices.text: Spend 3 scraps riveting on protective ribs (+3 max HP)
Sell 2 max HP of button plating for 26 gold
Leave the washboard humming in the dark

events.title: The Dollhouse Shutter
events.description: A nursery shutter taller than the dolls has folded across a moonlit landing. The Warden braces its iron hinge with his broad patched shield while two tiny quilted figures tap from behind the slats.

choices.text: Spend 2 scraps padding the hinge (heal 5 HP; gain 1 max HP)
Pull the brass latch free (lose 4 HP; gain 24 gold)
Leave the little figures behind the shutter

events.title: The Milk-Glass Shade
events.description: A giant frosted lamp shade lies across a midnight pantry, filled with the silhouettes of cloth moths. The Lantern Monk raises his warm amber lantern to a crack where they gather in silence.

choices.text: Pay 14 gold for a warm wick (heal 8 HP)
Pull silk from the sharp glass rim (lose 6 HP; gain 3 scraps)
Let the moth shadows settle behind the glass

events.title: The Iron Bootjack
events.description: A rusted bootjack straddles the doll-sized hall like a crooked arch. The Scarecrow steadies it with his pitchfork while his black crow pecks at a torn straw perch beneath the iron heel.

choices.text: Spend 2 scraps sewing a padded perch (heal 3 HP; gain 2 max HP)
Trade straw from your frame (lose 2 max HP; gain 26 gold)
Leave the crow guarding its iron perch

events.title: The Ink-Glass Chandelier
events.description: An upside-down chandelier of ink-black glass thimbles hangs across the narrow nursery corridor. The Rag Duelist's needle rapier holds its snapped chain while a little stitched dancer waits in the trembling amber light.

choices.text: Spend spare thread to bind the chain and strengthen your seams.
Cut away lasting stuffing to claim the hidden purse.
Lower the rapier and let the glass stop swaying.

events.title: The Needle Pendulum
events.description: Two enormous knitting needles swing like the hands of a broken clock over a child's dark passage. The Yarn Ranger throws a wool bolas across their path as sewn mice huddle beneath the ticking points.

choices.text: Pay for strong wool and re-tie a lasting seam.
Unpick a permanent stitch for a bundle of salvage.
Draw back the bolas and pass beneath the needles.

events.title: The Velvet Turnstile
events.description: A brass turnstile made from huge coat buttons blocks a velvet-lined corridor. The Button Golem braces the jammed wheel with both round fists while tiny ragdoll wardens peer through its buttonholes.

choices.text: Sew on spare thread to reinforce your body and recover.
Give up lasting stuffing and sell the brass spindle.
Release the wheel and follow the velvet passage.

events.title: The Wardrobe-Latch Oath
events.description: Inside the wall of a sleeping house, a wardrobe latch looms like a barred bridge. A tiny button-eyed caretaker holds out a bent brass staple; the Button Golem's chest-buttons answer with a dull knock.

choices.text: Sew the warding latch into the Golem's chest (stronger seams; spend scraps)
Give the caretaker a chest stud (gold now; weaker seams ahead)
Let the wardrobe door settle in silence

events.title: The Loom-Bridge Knot
events.description: A fallen handloom spans a black gap between floorboards, its wool warp a bridge no wider than a doll's foot. The Yarn Ranger hooks her giant braided bolas around the last sound beam while unseen feet tug below.

choices.text: Bind your bolas into a lasting safety seam (stronger stuffing; spend gold)
Cut away the mooring wool (gain scraps; suffer a wound)
Cross another way and leave the loom to creak

events.title: The Tuning-Fork Oath
events.description: A silver tuning fork lodged in an old stair rings whenever the hallway candle shivers. The Rag Duelist's needle rapier hums in reply, and a cape-shaped shadow holds out a crooked spool of red thread.

choices.text: Sew the echo into your cape (heal and reinforce it; spend scraps)
Trade the cape's strongest thread (gain gold; lose lasting padding)
Sheathe the rapier and let the note fade

events.title: The Ash-Warm Thermos
events.description: A child's thermos taller than the little dolls blocks the corridor. Its soot-red shell bears scratched golden stars, and a round button-eyed keeper cups a fading ember beneath its loose lid.

choices.text: Share the last warmth and stitch its ember into a stronger seam.
Trade the copper lid for coin; the warm padding goes with it.
Let the little keeper shelter its final coal.

events.title: The Soot-Collector's Dustpan
events.description: A rust-rimmed household dustpan leans against the black corridor wall like an iron roof. Little button eyes peer out of its soot while a broom with loose red-yarn bristles sweeps by itself.

choices.text: Let the Tinker rethread the broom and reinforce a worn seam.
Search the ash for loose scraps; breathe in its choking dust.
Leave the broom to sweep the same patch of shadow.

events.title: The Rolling Pin of Lost Faces
events.description: A wooden rolling pin as broad as a handcart lies across the hall. Tiny faces have pressed themselves into the worn grain, and its iron axle rocks while no hand comes near.

choices.text: Have the Button Golem bind the iron axle into a lasting brace.
Trade away the stout axle for coin and lose some padding.
Step around the roller before it turns again.

events.title: The Tarnished Silver Tray
events.description: An upturned silver serving tray bridges a doll-wide black drain; the Warden wedges his vast quilted shield beneath its bent handle as red candle wax drips through the rim.

choices.text: Spend 2 scraps padding the tray's shield-braced lip (+3 max HP)
Pry off the silver serving stamp (lose 5 HP; gain 24 gold)
Leave the silver tray spanning the dark drain

events.title: The Ivory Music Stand
events.description: A towering ivory music stand leans across a cracked parlour floor; the Seamstress threads her enormous needle through a velvet scorebook before the stand's brass teeth snap shut.

choices.text: Pay 16 gold to stitch a soft velvet bandage (heal 9 HP)
Unpick 2 max HP of scorebook ribbon to salvage 3 scraps
Close the music book and leave the stand still

events.title: The Clockwork Spice Tin
events.description: A spice tin bigger than a cottage rattles beside an attic skirting board; through its lid the Tinker's crooked goggles catch a copper crank turning tiny rusted gears by candlelight.

choices.text: Spend 1 scrap fitting a stronger copper lining (+2 max HP)
Strip the hot crank gears (lose 6 HP; gain 3 scraps)
Let the clockwork tin rattle on in the dark

events.title: The Stovepipe Hinge
events.description: A giant soot-black stovepipe leans through a narrow attic corridor. The Warden braces its buckled brass hinge with his quilted shield while a tiny ember glows behind the grate.

choices.text: Stitch the hinge firm and reinforce the Warden's stuffing
Burn some stuffing to salvage the blackened bolts
Leave the ember breathing behind the grate

events.title: The Shadow Embroidery Screen
events.description: An embroidery screen taller than the dolls blocks a moonlit passage. The Seamstress traces the silhouettes of lost puppets in its oxblood silk while an empty needle taps the wooden frame.

choices.text: Buy silk and sew a lasting lining beneath the screen
Unpick the Seamstress's own seam for ghostly threads
Let the puppet shadows hold their place

events.title: The Hollow Windsock
events.description: A weather-beaten cloth windsock hangs from a doll-sized vent high in the corridor. The Scarecrow's ribbon-feather crows circle its hollow throat as cold air pulls straw from his sleeve.

choices.text: Stuff the windsock's heart and reinforce the Scarecrow
Trade a lasting seam for the wind's hidden coin
Let the wind swallow the crow calls
